scope: Bounded read-only review of DISCOVERY-EXPANSION-DESIGN-R2 together with DISCOVERY-EXPANSION-RECOVERY-R3. Checked whether R3 closes the R2 IO blockers for control serialization, initialization recovery, control-head event membership, reservation counters, candidate component introductions and state recovery. No source, schema, test, Git, connector, Vault or network mutation.
amendment_effect: R3 explicitly prevails over conflicting R2 text. It changes config to carry seeds, removes control_head/user_stop from the calculated stop artifact, adds event.control_head, introduces one checkout-root advisory flock protocol, replaces the 256-file decisions limit with a 512-file physical limit plus semantic sublimits, and defines component-introduction accounting.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 8-33 require every discovery reader and writer to take the same non-blocking LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB on the retained checkout-root directory descriptor before observing .work, hold it through all graph/input/resource checks, installs, final checks and cleanup, and return DISCOVERY_BUSY without scanning or writing. R3 also states the lock is advisory/cooperative and that retained named-edge/set/byte checks remain authoritative for uncooperative filesystem changes.
checks.closure: This supplies the missing linearization boundary for cooperative control, plan, observation and event commands. A control installed before event installation is seen by the later operation; a control installed after the event must target the new completed event. The no-lock-file/no-stale-lock rule avoids a mutable lock artifact.
remaining_acceptance: Run the two-process busy/release probe on both supported macOS and Linux environments; the local macOS feasibility observation does not prove Linux behavior.
Prove that all status/context/render/handoff readers acquire the same lock and that busy acquisition performs no .work creation or store scan.
Replace the named checkout root while a descriptor is held and verify actual approved checkout identity plus final named-edge checks yield WORK_PATH_UNSAFE rather than permitting two aliased roots.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 35-55 puts exact canonical seeds into research-config.data, reduces research-session.data to {session_key,config}, and defines absent, config-only/init_pending, matching ready, session-only, multi-artifact, wrong-ref and changed-input states. A config-only tree therefore contains all facts needed to reconstruct one expected session.
checks.closure: The R2 config/session information split is removed. Different seed inputs change config bytes; exact config reuse can derive the session under the shared lock; foreign or incomplete trees are refusal states. Plain resume is an exact session repair in init_pending and read-only status remains non-creating.
remaining_acceptance: Freeze the canonical seed ordering/normalization and require session_key to equal the retained directory slug before deriving the session.
Test config-only same-byte init/resume, changed seeds, changed config, session-only/config-missing, wrong config ref, multiple configs and foreign artifacts.

Include config itself in the initial physical-size reserve or prove the global config bound separately; the pending-plan reserve described later cannot cover an absent initial config unless this is explicit.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 57-73 removes control_head and user_stop from research-stop-decision, limits the calculated artifact to four deterministic reasons, gives active user_stop status overlay precedence, and makes assessment/candidate/rank/stop bytes independent of control advancement.
checks.closure: Calculated stop projections remain reproducible after user_stop/resume and do not pretend that a user instruction was part of the semantic calculation. The historical control state is carried by plan/event, while effective status is derived separately.
remaining_acceptance: Update the successor schema/validator so a stop containing the old R2 control fields is rejected and event.control_head is required.
Prove a pending exact projection set can finish after user_stop then explicit control.resume without rewriting sealed plan or projection bytes.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 65-67 adds event.control_head as the actual head observed at event installation while holding the shared lock, and requires plan.control_head to be an ancestor or equal. Lines 75-98 define sequence/previous ordering, global event_id uniqueness, round membership, user_stop/resume preconditions, and historical group checks.
checks.closure: The final event now records the linearized current control head rather than inheriting a stale plan head. A control command that wins the lock before finish is in the event head; one that follows event installation references the new completed event. `control.round` is null before the first event or exactly the last completed event, and event heads are checked against the preceding-round control group without filesystem mtime.
remaining_acceptance: Race control install immediately before/during/after event installation and verify the three allowed outcomes: event includes the preceding head, later control targets the completed event, or an unsafe foreign change refuses.
Check two controls in one pending-round group, controls across rounds, equal recorded_at values, duplicate exact retries and same event_id with changed fields.
Validate the event.control_head field itself and the no-current-event back-edge in the rw3 graph.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 100-142 freezes canonical byte ordering, zero-based plan slots, domain-separated request keys, exact request regeneration, one terminal observation per slot, the full cumulative terminal observation set, exact assessment/candidate-set/event memberships, pending subset rules, deterministic projection bytes and active-ancestry validation.
checks.closure: R2 membership blockers are materially closed. Missing expected files remain pending; extra/alternate/foreign files conflict; an event cannot authorize a successor until its complete child set exists. Failed, partial, timeout, rate-limited, unavailable and empty terminal observations are part of the cumulative context, while assessment evidence is only a citation subset.
remaining_acceptance: Replay all partial install points and assert exact missing slots/children, no arrival-order selection and no event with a missing child.
Verify all historical input_set_sha256 values and candidate/rank/stop projections are recomputed in sequence before memo-cache reuse.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 144-167 defines reservation_after as four exact plan-time counters, reserves every request and terminal-observation slot before request materialization, and defines event budget_after counters including completed rounds, materialized/pending request and observation counts, retries, result records, normalized payload bytes, candidate reservations and current components. Lines 163-167 distinguish normalized payload bytes, stored failure bytes and invalid uninstalled input, with no refund.
checks.closure: The R2 reservation ambiguity is resolved: plans debit declared slots atomically; terminal failures/partial/empty outcomes debit observation slots; malformed input with no artifact leaves the slot pending; retries are fresh later-plan slots; exact reuse adds zero; no round/request/observation/retry reservation is refunded.
remaining_acceptance: Bind each counter to one schema type and validator formula, including the configured 32-request/32-observation/16MiB payload/2048-result limits inherited from R2.
Show status counters for a pending-ready projection and prove candidate semantic slots are not refunded when later identity facts bridge or alias components.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 169-179 replaces literal key-union counting with cumulative identity-component introductions: a component consumes a slot only when its identifier set is disjoint from all earlier identifiers; a bridge merging prior components and aliases joining an existing component do not refund or consume a new slot; every conflict counts.
checks.closure: This closes the R2 concern that an explicit same_work bridge could silently change a candidate key or refund an earlier candidate. Historical snapshots and keys remain immutable, while each current snapshot is derived from the complete graph and must stay at <=256 components and <=256 cumulative introduced slots.
remaining_acceptance: Exercise first-round component introduction, same_work bridge with a new alias, bridge joining two old components, conflicting namespaces and a 257th disjoint component.
Verify candidate decisions remain bound to their historical snapshot even when a later snapshot has a changed component key.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 181-190 changes physical decisions capacity to 512 saved files and sets semantic maxima of 256 candidate decisions, 64 controls and 8 assessments, for a maximum 328 decisions-family files. It explicitly reserves one assessment slot per plan and prevents controls/candidate decisions from consuming that reserved assessment capacity.
checks.closure: The R2 arithmetic contradiction (eight assessments plus 256 candidate decisions plus controls in a 256-file family) is removed. The declared 512 physical ceiling has room for the 328 semantic maximum, subject to byte limits and the final exact schema/path allowlist.
remaining_acceptance: Test 8 assessments + 256 candidate decisions + 64 controls and refusal at the 512-file/32MiB/64MiB boundaries.
Prove candidate/control writes cannot consume a pending plan's reserved finalization bytes; a capacity refusal never deletes the existing assessment or candidate evidence.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 202-235 supplies the complete base state/action table, current user_stop precedence, explicit control.resume requirement, pending plan/assessment/projection behavior, candidate decision allowance on completed rounds, operation payload fields and DISCOVERY_BUSY/DISCOVERY_PENDING/STOPPED handling.
checks.closure: R2 state ambiguity is materially resolved. No successor plan appears before a complete predecessor; no empty frontier plan is written; plain resume repairs only when permitted; user_stop blocks all mutating research actions and only explicit control.resume clears that overlay. Calculated stops remain reviewable for candidate decisions.
remaining_acceptance: Verify every matrix cell and effective user_stop overlay, including config-only init_pending and a stop arriving during each pending stage.
Ensure status/context/render/handoff stay non-creating and report base_state, effective_state, control_head and all pending sets.

checks.evidence: R3 lines 192-200 requires an explicit conservative byte reserve before a plan and says controls/other files must not strand valid observations, but gives no numeric reserve constants or schema-size proof. The amendment therefore leaves the final physical-capacity contract open.
checks.finding: A semantic reservation ledger alone cannot guarantee that a valid terminal observation can still finalize candidate/rank/stop/event. The reserve must cover exact saved bytes, inherited aggregate payload/result limits, per-family 32MiB limits, total 64MiB, initial config/session installation, and non-reserved control/decision writes.

review_note_on_proposed_values.nominal_sum_before_slack: 12992 KiB (12.6875 MiB), leaving 1344 KiB below a 14 MiB pending-plan reserve.
review_note_on_proposed_values.required_consistency: The proof must also apply the inherited 16 MiB total normalized_payload_bytes bound; otherwise 32 observations at 1 MiB payload plus 64 KiB file headroom would exceed the 32 MiB observations-family limit. A separate initial-config reserve and a non-reserved control/decision byte budget are required.

required_freeze: Bind numeric maxima to exact serialized envelope bytes, including config/session, and define rounding/slack and remaining-space formulas.
Reserve one pending plan only; preflight prospective candidate-set/rank bounds before accepting a terminal observation; prevent controls/candidate decisions from consuming that reserve.
Prove the reserve against all inherited semantic limits and both per-family/total store byte scans, including failure-object bytes and event bytes.
Specify what happens when a user control cannot fit in non-reserved physical space; it must not silently consume finalization reserve or overwrite evidence.

closed_or_materially_closed: Cooperative control/round serialization via one checkout-root flock, with event.control_head as the linearized event head.
Config-only initialization reconstruction because config now carries canonical seeds.
Separate deterministic stop projection and effective user-stop overlay.
Exact pending memberships and cumulative terminal observation inputs.
Plan/event reservation counters and no-refund semantic debits.
Candidate component-introduction counting without refunds after bridge/alias facts.
Decisions-family arithmetic via the 512-file physical cap and semantic sublimits.
State/action transition matrix and explicit control.resume behavior.
still_open_before_freeze: Numeric physical pending-plan/config/control reserve and exact byte proof.
Linux flock and full implementation race acceptance; macOS feasibility alone is insufficient.
Schema/resource/path updates for the amended stop/event/config shapes.
Provider target grammar remains a separate freeze item from R2.

acceptance_vectors: Two-process checkout-directory flock on macOS and Linux: busy command returns DISCOVERY_BUSY without .work creation; release permits the next command.
Uncooperative checkout/.work/family replacement while a lock-held command runs; actual approved identity and final named-edge checks yield WORK_PATH_UNSAFE.
Absent/config-only/session-only/multiple/wrong-ref init trees with same-byte and changed-input retries; status remains non-creating.
Control inserted before, during and after finish; event.control_head, control.round grouping and later control predecessor must be exact, with no stale finish.
Interrupt after every install edge; verify reservation counters, pending sets, complete memberships, event-last behavior and no refunds.
Introduce components, merge with same_work, add aliases, create conflicts and exceed 256 disjoint components; verify candidate_slots_reserved never decreases.
Fill 8 assessments, 256 candidate decisions and 64 controls; test 512-file, per-family-byte and total-store-byte refusal without deletion or reserve consumption.
Use full/partial/failure/empty observations under total payload/result caps; preflight candidate/rank/stop/event bounds before observation install and compare exact replay bytes.
remaining_gates: Architect must add and freeze the numeric physical reserve and initial-config/non-reserved-control accounting before implementation freeze.
Implementation must provide cross-platform flock, retained descriptor and all-exit named-set tests; design feasibility is not product acceptance.
Successor schemas/resources and exact final path allowlist must reflect config seeds, stop-field removal and event.control_head.
No builder dispatch, source implementation, Git mutation, live provider access, real Vault use or scientific/human gate closure follows from this review.
